# Agents directions for C++ projects

* The versions for all components are defined in the root CMake files. Other files that expose or use the version information must be generated by CMake from templates, patched by scripts, or extracted to expose the correct version. This includes build scripts that use the version as part of the artifact names.

## Naming conventions

**never** use Microsoft style variable names

* Class names: `ClassName`
* Class/struct puiblic members: `some_name`
* Class/struct private/protected names: `some_name_`
* Variables in code: `some_name`;

## Language

* Use C++20/23.
* Prefer `(if auto *p = foo()) {} ` over old style code.
* Prefer templates over repeated code.
* Prefer std::view and std::span over pointers and references when creating functions that reads buffers they don't own.
* Prefer concepts and/or `if consexpr ()` over legacy template deduction with alternative implementations
* Prefer constexpr variables for constants.
* Prefer std::view over `const char*` and other legacy C types.

## Libraries
* Prefer my own libraries
* Logging: logfault. Use a project specifig header-file like: https://github.com/jgaa/next-app/blob/main/include/nextapp/logging.h. Start simple and add project types on demand (useful to log context information to simple log statements).
* When adding external libraries, prefer to let cmake handle it. Use the default branch when fetching from git (we can lock it in version branches). If relevant, make sure that flatpak builds and offline builds can use the same cmake file. Example:

```cmake
if(SHARED_LOGFAULT_SOURCE_DIR)
    if(EXISTS "${SHARED_LOGFAULT_SOURCE_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt")
        message(STATUS "shared_desktop: using local logfault from ${SHARED_LOGFAULT_SOURCE_DIR}")
        FetchContent_Declare(logfault SOURCE_DIR "${SHARED_LOGFAULT_SOURCE_DIR}")
    else()
        message(FATAL_ERROR "SHARED_LOGFAULT_SOURCE_DIR is set but invalid: ${SHARED_LOGFAULT_SOURCE_DIR}")
    endif()
else()
    FetchContent_Declare(logfault
        GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/jgaa/logfault.git
        GIT_TAG master
    )
endif()

FetchContent_MakeAvailable(logfault)
```


## Qt and QML (if used)
* For QML, never use components from Qt Labs.
* Don't add new Qt libraries without asking first
* Use lowerCamelCase for QSettings key names within slash-separated groups.
